description: Tracks active open-source AI agent repositories from GitHub signals.

items.description: The agent that grows with you
AI productivity studio with smart chat, autonomous agents, and 300+ assistants. Unified access to frontier LLMs
Ultra-lightweight, open-source, self-hosted personal AI agent framework in Python with WebUI, tools, memory, MCP, multi-agent workflows, automation, and chat apps
DeepSeek-native AI coding agent for your terminal. Engineered around prefix-cache stability — leave it running.

NocoBase is an open-source AI + no-code platform for building business systems fast. Instead of generating everything from scratch, AI works on top of production-proven infrastructure and a WYSIWYG no-code interface, so you get both speed and reliability.
⌥  AI Coding agent for the terminal — hash-anchored edits, optimized tool harness, LSP, Python, browser, subagents, and more

Agent OS: Stop prompting. Start specifying. A Socratic interview gates the spec on an ambiguity score, then one command drives execution, a 3-stage evaluation gate, and a budgeted evolution loop. MCP server, 13 runtimes: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Copilot, Kiro and more.
A trilingual (繁中 / English / 简中) learning roadmap for agentic AI: from LLM basics to multi-agent systems, with 240+ curated resources and hands-on examples. 中文 AI agent 學習地圖。
A persistent workspace for development work that self-improves and continues beyond one session.
The micro-VM for AI agents — light enough to embed on your laptop, elastic enough to power an agentic cloud.
Zero, your trustworthy AI teammate for real work.
Open-source, local-first desktop AI research workbench for scientific computing with Python/R, MCP bioinformatics tools, SSH/WSL/GPU runtimes, and OpenAI/Anthropic models.

Local-first, agent-native control plane for ComfyUI — MCP server + sidebar agent that generates images, video & audio, authors and runs workflows, and edits your live graph in natural language on ANY LLM (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, offline Ollama, or any hosted model). 178 tools, 36 AI skills, 55 installer packs. Local, LAN, VPS, or Comfy Cloud.
Turn any research paper into a commercialization report — 6 AI agents, TRL/MRL scoring, patent landscape, market intelligence, verified citations. DeepSeek / OpenAI / Claude.

AgenticX is a unified, production-ready multi-agent platform — Python SDK + CLI (agx) + Studio server + Machi desktop app. Features Meta-Agent orchestration, 15+ LLM providers, MCP Hub, hierarchical memory, avatar & group chat, skill ecosystem, safety sandbox, and IM gateway (Feishu/WeChat).
